Mitigation: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Release history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent version that had been healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back:** Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** across all production regions.

3. **Verified:** Post-rollback, checkout-api is now healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2% (recovered from 18%).

4. **Opened incident:** Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the health check failures and the mitigation taken. The on-call engineer was paged. Follow-up should include investigating the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before any redeploy attempt.
